content.title: Why Inspire Medical Systems (INSP) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of medical technology company Inspire Medical Systems (NYSE:INSP) jumped 5.3% in the morning session after the stock's positive momentum continued as Morgan Stanley raised its price target. Investors seemed to focus on the positive aspect of the analyst's note, which was the increased price target to $130 from $105. This suggested that despite the more neutral rating, the firm saw a higher potential valuation for the company's shares than it did before.
